notes: The sheet is drawn on the John/Central grid; the West End streets in the west third (Smith Alley, Mound, and the Hopkins, Clark, Chestnut and Elizabeth legs west of John) run on a grid rotated ~16-17 degrees, so Hopkins and Clark each meet John as two offset T's: Hopkins diagonal leg at y 1803 vs east leg 1971; Clark diagonal leg (printed 500-block addresses, 50 ft) at 2713 vs east leg 2825. East of Central the cross streets are offset from those west of it: Betts (west, 40 ft) vs West 14th (east, printed 'W-14TH'); Laurel west leg y 1097 vs east leg y 1050 (east leg unlabelled here, named LAUREL on sheet 64); Ann, West 12th ('W-12TH') and Charles exist only east of Central; Hopkins, Clark, Chestnut, Elizabeth only west of it. Betts: only its south line is on the sheet (north line falls above the paper edge); centre = south line minus half the printed 40 ft, +/-15. Elizabeth: only the north line is on the sheet; centre = north line + ~100 px using the printed 60 ft (the water pipe runs ~30 px north of that). Elizabeth is printed 50 ft on the diagonal part near Mound. John is printed 50 ft north of Chestnut and 40 ft south of it; John/Chestnut and John/Elizabeth marked cross because John's pipe and lines continue south off the sheet. Hopkins printed 44 ft near John and 40 ft near Central. Rankin Alley is unlabelled here; identified from sheet 62 (Rankin Alley meets Smith Alley there). Smith Alley printed 'SMITH ALLEY' 12 ft; Bard Alley printed 'ALLEY' + 'BARD'; Gamble Alley 'ALLEY' + 'GAMBLE'; Truman Alley 'ALLEY' + 'TRUMAN' (narrows to ~5 ft at Clark); Isaac printed 'ISAAC' only, 12 ft. Unnamed alleys: 10 ft E-W alley Bard to Gamble (block 2); 10 ft E-W alley from John east to the rear of the Central Av lots (dead end ~x 3105, block 3); 10 ft N-S alley (labelled only 'ALLEY') from that alley south to Hopkins at x ~2911, roughly in line with Isaac Alley's north end (x 2889). Central Avenue (60 ft) centre drifts from x 3373 at Betts to 3322 at Elizabeth. Street suffixes not printed (BETTS, LAUREL, HOPKINS, CLARK, CHESTNUT, ELIZABETH, JOHN, MOUND, ANN, CHARLES); 'Street' assumed.
